plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 30-Minute End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary for the buyer-side recreate flow.
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the case.
Open Recreate Order from the stage Settings menu.
Assert that the Recreate Order pop-up opened with Product Sheet.
Assert that the recreate configuration content is present.
Assert that the delivery-date control is present in the pop-up.
Assert that the scheduling choice is available.
Assert that the event end-time duration control offers the required 30 Mins option.
Assert that the recreate dialog exposes the final Create Order action.
Create the recreated event using the selected duration and the unchanged default evaluation/scheduling choices.
